1.web: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took some men.
1.asv: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, tookmen:

2.web: They rose up before Moses, with some of the children of Israel, two hundred fifty princes of the congregation, called to the assembly, men of renown.
2.asv: and they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the congregation, called to the assembly, men of renown;

3.web: They assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, “You take too much on yourself, since all the congregation are holy, everyone of them, and Yahweh is among them! Why do you lift yourselves up above Yahweh’s assembly?”
3.asv: and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, Ye take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and Jehovah is among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the assembly of Jehovah?

4.web: When Moses heard it, he fell on his face.
4.asv: And when Moses heard it, he fell upon his face:

5.web: He said to Korah and to all his company, “In the morning, Yahweh will show who are his, and who is holy, and will cause him to come near to him. Even him whom he shall choose, he will cause to come near to him.
5.asv: and he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, In the morning Jehovah will show who are his, and who is holy, and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he shall choose will he cause to come near unto him.

6.web: Do this: take censers, Korah, and all his company;
6.asv: This do: take you censers, Korah, and all his company;

7.web: and put fire in them, and put incense on them before Yahweh tomorrow. It shall be that the man whom Yahweh chooses, he shall be holy. You have gone too far, you sons of Levi!”
7.asv: and put fire in them, and put incense upon them before Jehovah to-morrow: and it shall be that the man whom Jehovah doth choose, he shall be holy: ye take too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.

8.web: Moses said to Korah, “Hear now, you sons of Levi!
8.asv: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear now, ye sons of Levi:

9.web: Is it a small thing to you, that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself, to do the service of Yahweh’s tabernacle, and to stand before the congregation to minister to them;
9.asv: seemeth it but a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself, to do the service of the tabernacle of Jehovah, and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them;

10.web: and that he has brought you near, and all your brothers the sons of Levi with you? Do you seek the priesthood also?
10.asv: and that he hath brought thee near, and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee? and seek ye the priesthood also?

11.web: Therefore you and all your company have gathered together against Yahweh! What is Aaron that you murmur against him?”
11.asv: Therefore thou and all thy company are gathered together against Jehovah: and Aaron, what is he that ye murmur against him?

12.web: Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; and they said, “We won’t come up!
12.asv: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; and they said, We will not come up:

13.web: Is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, but you must also make yourself a prince over us?
13.asv: is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, but thou must needs make thyself also a prince over us?

14.web: Moreover you haven’t brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you put out the eyes of these men? We won’t come up.”
14.asv: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.

15.web: Moses was very angry, and said to Yahweh, “Don’t respect their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them, neither have I hurt one of them.”
15.asv: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto Jehovah, Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.

16.web: Moses said to Korah, “You and all your company go before Yahweh, you, and they, and Aaron, tomorrow.
16.asv: And Moses said unto Korah, Be thou and all thy company before Jehovah, thou, and they, and Aaron, to-morrow:

17.web: Each man take his censer, and put incense on them, and each man bring before Yahweh his censer, two hundred fifty censers; you also, and Aaron, each his censer.”
17.asv: and take ye every man his censer, and put incense upon them, and bring ye before Jehovah every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; thou also, and Aaron, each his censer.

18.web: They each took his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense on it, and stood at the door of the Tent of Meeting with Moses and Aaron.
18.asv: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood at the door of the tent of meeting with Moses and Aaron.

19.web: Korah assembled all the congregation opposite them to the door of the Tent of Meeting. Yahweh’s glory appeared to all the congregation.
19.asv: And Korah assembled all the congregation against them unto the door of the tent of meeting: and the glory of Jehovah appeared unto all the congregation.

20.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
20.asv: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

21.web: “Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!”
21.asv: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.

22.web: They fell on their faces, and said, “God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be angry with all the congregation?”
22.asv: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation?

23.asv: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

24.web: “Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get away from around the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram!’”
24.asv: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.

25.web: Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.
25.asv: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.

26.web: He spoke to the congregation, saying, “Depart, please, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest you be consumed in all their sins!”
26.asv: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest ye be consumed in all their sins.

27.web: So they went away from the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side. Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents, with their wives, their sons, and their little ones.
27.asv: So they gat them up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little ones.

28.web: Moses said, “Hereby you shall know that Yahweh has sent me to do all these works; for they are not from my own mind.
28.asv: And Moses said, Hereby ye shall know that Jehovah hath sent me to do all these works; for I have not done them of mine own mind.

29.web: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they experience what all men experience, then Yahweh hasn’t sent me.
29.asv: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then Jehovah hath not sent me.

30.web: But if Yahweh makes a new thing, and the ground opens its mouth, and swallows them up, with all that belong to them, and they go down alive into Sheol; then you shall understand that these men have despised Yahweh.”
30.asv: But if Jehovah make a new thing, and the ground open its mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain unto them, and they go down alive into Sheol; then ye shall understand that these men have despised Jehovah.

31.web: As he made an end of speaking all these words, the ground that was under them split apart.
31.asv: And it came to pass, as he made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that was under them;

32.web: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, with their households, all of Korah’s men, and all their goods.
32.asv: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.

33.web: So they, and all that belonged to them went down alive into Sheol. The earth closed on them, and they perished from among the assembly.
33.asv: So they, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into Sheol: and the earth closed upon them, and they perished from among the assembly.

34.web: All Israel that were around them fled at their cry; for they said, “Lest the earth swallow us up!”
34.asv: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them; for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up.

35.web: Fire came out from Yahweh, and devoured the two hundred fifty men who offered the incense.
35.asv: And fire came forth from Jehovah, and devoured the two hundred and fifty men that offered the incense.

36.asv: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

37.web: “Speak to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter the fire away from the camp; for they are holy,
37.asv: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are holy,

38.web: even the censers of these sinners against their own lives. Let them be made beaten plates for a covering of the altar, for they offered them before Yahweh. Therefore they are holy. They shall be a sign to the children of Israel.”
38.asv: even the censers of these sinners against their own lives; and let them be made beaten plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before Jehovah; therefore they are holy; and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel.

39.web: Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers, which those who were burnt had offered; and they beat them out for a covering of the altar,
39.asv: And Eleazar the priest took the brazen censers, which they that were burnt had offered; and they beat them out for a covering of the altar,

40.web: to be a memorial to the children of Israel, to the end that no stranger, who isn’t of the seed of Aaron, would come near to burn incense before Yahweh, that he not be as Korah, and as his company; as Yahweh spoke to him by Moses.
40.asv: to be a memorial unto the children of Israel, to the end that no stranger, that is not of the seed of Aaron, come near to burn incense before Jehovah; that he be not as Korah, and as his company: as Jehovah spake unto him by Moses.

41.web: But on the next day all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, “You have killed Yahweh’s people!”
41.asv: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, Ye have killed the people of Jehovah.

42.web: When the congregation was assembled against Moses and against Aaron, They looked toward the Tent of Meeting. Behold, the cloud covered it, and Yahweh’s glory appeared.
42.asv: And it came to pass, when the congregation was assembled against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tent of meeting: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of Jehovah appeared.

43.web: Moses and Aaron came to the front of the Tent of Meeting.
43.asv: And Moses and Aaron came to the front of the tent of meeting.

44.asv: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

45.web: “Get away from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!” They fell on their faces.
45.asv: Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.

46.web: Moses said to Aaron, “Take your censer, and put fire from off the altar in it, and lay incense on it, and carry it quickly to the congregation, and make atonement for them; for wrath has gone out from Yahweh! The plague has begun.”
46.asv: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take thy censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and lay incense thereon, and carry it quickly unto the congregation, and make atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from Jehovah; the plague is begun.

47.web: Aaron did as Moses said, and ran into the midst of the assembly. Behold, the plague has begun among the people. He put on the incense, and made atonement for the people.
47.asv: And Aaron took as Moses spake, and ran into the midst of the assembly; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people: and he put on the incense, and made atonement for the people.

48.web: He stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
48.asv: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.

49.web: Now those who died by the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, besides those who died about the matter of Korah.
49.asv: Now they that died by the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, besides them that died about the matter of Korah.

50.web: Aaron returned to Moses to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and the plague was stopped.
50.asv: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tent of meeting: and the plague was stayed.
